summary: Executed full backend+frontend validation for Binance reference feed, independent manual UP/DOWN paper buys, responsive sticky quote bar redesign, README download endpoint, and regression suite on public deployment.

minor.issue: Observed occasional live-timing abort/409 during first-attempt execute in one run; fresh quote retry succeeded and final deterministic flow passed.

action_items: Optional hardening: improve manual execute first-attempt stability around rapid market micro-changes/rollover to reduce abort frequency under live timing.
No blocking defects found in tested scope.
critical_code_review_comments: Feed/guardrail implementation correctly separates single-side manual integrity from cross-book sync and keeps official_price_to_beat null.
No critical env hardcoding or Mongo _id serialization defects observed in exercised paths.
Session-scoped idempotency for manual execute is implemented and validated.
test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md before auth tests; file exists but has no credentials (not required for this session-based app flow).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested: https://arb-finder-5m.preview.emergentagent.com. Health verified all Polymarket markets connected and Binance BTC/ETH/SOL LIVE. Added feature tests for /api/reference, /api/readme, manual quote/execute safeguards (accept_directional_risk, TTL expiry, idempotency, both-side OPEN_POSITION history), and asset/reference switching. Responsive checks at 1250/768/390 showed no horizontal overflow with sticky share-price bar. Manual UI flow executed UP and DOWN buys from confirmation dialog with OPEN POSITION visible in activity.
rca of the issue: Minor non-blocking behavior observed: manual execute can return ABORTED/409 on first attempt when live book/market state shifts between quote and execute despite deterministic latency/failure settings. Reproduction: request quote near fast-changing window then execute immediately. Mitigation already available in product: refresh quote and retry; structural fix option is tighter execution-window messaging or pre-execute fast refresh tokening.
